section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REMOVE DIFFERENTIAL

content.description: Illustration showing rear differential assembly with carrier bolts highlighted at the top, including suspension components and brake assembly

items: (a) Jack up differential and remove the carrier bolts.

content.description: Illustration showing the differential carrier being lowered with a jack positioned underneath the differential housing, with vehicle suspension and exhaust system visible

items: (b) Lower the differential carrier with a jack.

content.text: NOTE: When lowering the carrier, be careful that the differential does not separate.
